findings.quote: // An overlay open when this reply landed would otherwise survive
findings.what: This function also handles the refresh path for an already-open config pane, so a re-read reply landing while the operator deliberately has the overlay up over that same pane now closes it under them with no keypress, a behaviour change the commit does not describe.

The settings reply (`Msg::Settings` landing after `s` then `h`) replaces `self.body` with the settings screen by the same mechanism yet is not given the `keymap_open = false` reset, so the identical leak the commit describes remains reachable on that third body-replacing reply.
